author: D. T. Martin
title: Drake School enrolls 6 Asian and Pacific Islander students for 2025-26
text:
Drake School had six Asian and Pacific Islander students enrolled for the 2025-26 school year, an increase of 50% from the prior year, data from the New York State Education Department indicated.
The school’s total enrollment reached 253, with Asian and Pacific Islander students making up 2.4% of the population and ranking as the third smallest ethnic group among all students.
The campus is part of the North Tonawanda City School District, which is managed from offices in North Tonawanda.
Of the district’s six schools, North Tonawanda Intermediate School reported the most Asian and Pacific Islander students, with 18 enrolled at that time.
World Population Review’s analysis found that while New York’s public education system ranked second nationwide overall , it placed 31st for K-12 performance.
